description: This file defines the ConfigHelper class in the OrangeHRM system, responsible for managing configuration paths, plugin configs, client configs, and global settings. It contains methods to retrieve directory paths, scan plugin directories, load plugin configurations, and aggregate various configuration data.

classes.name: ConfigHelper
classes.description: Helper class to manage and retrieve configuration paths and settings for OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getPathConfigs
methods.description: Returns a list of essential project directory paths based on the current directory structure.

methods.name: getPluginConfigs
methods.description: Scans the plugins directory for plugin folders ending with 'Plugin' and loads their configurations.

methods.name: getPluginConfiguration
methods.description: Loads a specific plugin configuration file if it exists in the plugin's config directory.

methods.name: getClientConfigs
methods.description: Retrieves client-specific configuration paths and version/build info.

methods.name: getGlobalConfigs
methods.description: Provides global configuration flags such as internationalization and date formatting.

methods.name: getConfigs
methods.description: Aggregates and returns all configuration settings collected by the helper.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific configuration value by name, with optional default.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns all the configuration data stored.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Merges new configuration parameters into the existing configs.
